title: astro-mmdc: Python SDK for the Markarian Multiwavelength Data Center (MMDC)
description: Python SDK for the Markarian Multiwavelength Data Center (MMDC, https://mmdc.am): retrieval of multiwavelength spectral energy distributions and light curves of blazars and other sources, on-demand Swift UVOT/XRT analysis, and broadband emission modeling of blazars with SSC, EIC and hadronic models. If you use it, please cite Sahakyan et al. 2024, AJ, 168, 289 (doi:10.3847/1538-3881/ad8231). Data retrieved through MMDC is licensed CC BY 4.0 and requires attribution.
